5. I agree to pay all expenses pertaining to exclusions / non-medical charges as mentioned by the  TPA / Insurance Co. would have to be paid by me.

7. in case if I undergo treatment for which the TPA / Insurance Co. withdraws authorization or rejects the claim.  then I am liable to pay all the bills of the hospital.

B. I agree to pay a security deposit of Rs. 10,000/- as mentioned by their respective TPA / Insurance Co.  The security deposit can be paid by cash 7 credit and debit card / pay order / RTGS / NEFT at the time of admission  The same will be refunded on settlement from TPA / Insurance Co. by RGTS only.
9. In case of refusal by TPA / insurance Co. for cashless or reimbursement of claims of the patient, the hospital will  not be responsible

10. All original reports and original discharge card will be handed over to the TPA / Insurance Co as per the  requirement of the TPA / Insurance Co. XeΓoK copies of the reports and discharge summary will be given by the  nursing department, where the patient is admitted in the ward.
11. The patient will be discharged only on receipt of the final approval from the TPA ⑇ Insurance Co. at the time of  discharge and complete settlement of the blk.

12. The TPA / Insurance Co. may take approximately 04-05 hours or more to send the final approval on the  day of discharge and this discharge process may take 06-08 hours. On the day of discharge. if discharge occurs  between 11 am b 3 pm then half day bed charges will be applicable and from 3 pm onwards full day bed charges  will be applicable. This will be irrespective of the final approval. If the TPA / Insurance Co. does not pay this bed  charge. then the patient will have to pay the same.
